player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I tracked the items by their initial names (e.g., "Black ball") rather than strictly tracking the object currently held by the target person (Eve) through each swap. This led to a confusion in Step 4 where I incorrectly assigned the "Black ball" to Eve instead of the "White present" she actually received from Dave. Next time, I will adopt a "target-focused" strategy: I will ignore the full state of all players and only track the specific object held by Eve. I will start with Eve's initial item (Orange ball) and update it only when Eve is explicitly mentioned in a swap. If Eve swaps with someone, I will replace her current item with the item that person is holding at that specific moment, which I must have tracked or deduced. If Eve is not involved in a swap, her item remains unchanged. This minimizes the cognitive load and reduces the chance of misattributing items between non-target players.
